product: Configure provider discounts for external model spend
tagline: Unity Gateway estimates external model spend using each provider's published list prices.
what_it_does: Unity Gateway estimates external model spend using each provider's published list prices. If your organization has negotiated different pricing with a provider, you can now configure a price multiplier on the model provider service so that spend estimates reflect those rates. Price multipliers only apply to external models accessed through model provider services, not Databricks hosted partner models.
